transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, what finally brought me in today is that I just feel like... the part of me that used to reach out for people and actually take pleasure in things has gone very quiet. I used to really enjoy my work, doing yoga, going to galleries, or even just journaling. But lately, I'm mostly just moving through my daily obligations. It feels like I'm just going through the motions now, without really feeling any of it.
How long have you been feeling this way?

I'd say it's been about eight months. This whole change in how I'm thinking, how I'm working, and just connecting with people... it's really been going on since we took my older relative into our apartment.
Do you still find pleasure in the activities you mentioned, such as yoga or journaling, even if it's just a little, or have you lost interest in them completely?

I'd say I've lost interest completely. I mean, I might still try to sit down with my journal, or unroll my mat, but... there's just nothing there. I don't get any sense of enjoyment or relief from it at all anymore. It just feels blank.
Do you feel sad or depressed most of the time?

No, not really. I wouldn't say I feel sad or depressed. It's not like I'm crying or feeling down in that way. It's more just... that blankness I mentioned. I just don't really feel much of anything at all.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight recently?
No, I haven't really noticed any big changes. My clothes still fit the same, so I think my weight has stayed pretty steady.
Do you feel anxious or on edge most of the time?
Not really, no. I don't feel nervous or on edge about things. It's... well, like I was saying before, it's mostly just that flat feeling. I'm not anxious, just sort of empty.
Do you often feel guilty about things?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I don't really have those kinds of thoughts. I don't feel guilty or blame myself for things. It's just... well, like I said, I just don't feel much. So, no, guilt isn't really something I'm experiencing.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or look forward to?

Not really, no. Honestly, that's what finally brought me in here. I just... I feel like the part of me that used to reach out for people, or take pleasure in things, has gone very quiet. I used to enjoy my work, doing yoga, going to galleries, even just journaling. But now, I don't really look forward to any of it. I'm mostly just moving through my obligations day to day.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from activities that you used to enjoy?

Yeah, exactly. That's... pretty much what I was just trying to say. I can go through the motions of doing things, but the actual pleasure or enjoyment I used to get from them... it's just not there anymore. It's all just completely flat.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than you used to, or that it's harder to get started on things?

No, I haven't really noticed that. I mean, I still get up and go to work, and I get things done at a normal pace. It's not physically harder to start things or anything like that... I just, like I said, don't get any enjoyment out of them once I'm doing them. But physically moving slower? No, I wouldn't say so.
Have you had any thoughts about not wanting to be alive or wishing you could just disappear?

No, I haven't had any thoughts like that. I know I was just saying how flat and empty things feel right now, but... I don't want to die or anything. I don't have any urges to harm myself or just disappear. It's really just the lack of enjoyment I was talking about, not a desire to not be here.
Do you feel like you're restless or fidgety, or that you can't seem to settle down?

No, not really. I don't feel restless or anything like that. I can sit still just fine... I don't feel like I have to be constantly moving or doing something. It's really just what I said before, about not enjoying things, but physically I feel normal. No fidgeting or anything.
Do you feel like you have less energy than you used to?

No, my energy levels are about the same as they've always been. I don't feel tired or drained... I have enough energy to get through my day and do my job. It's just the lack of interest in things, like I mentioned, but my actual energy is fine.
Do you feel like it's harder to think or make decisions than it used to be?

No, I haven't noticed any issues with that. My thinking is as clear as it usually is. I don't have any trouble making decisions... I mean, I make them all day at work without any problem. It really is just that flat feeling I mentioned earlier, but my mind itself is working perfectly fine.
Would you say this feeling of emptiness and lack of enjoyment is mild, moderate, or severe for you?

I would say it's mild. I mean, I'm not entirely sure how to measure it, but since I'm still getting through my day and doing my job without any real problems... it's definitely not severe. It's just sort of there in the background. So, yeah, probably mild.
How long have you been experiencing this mild level of emptiness and lack of enjoyment?

I'd say it's been about eight months. Yeah, right around eight months. It started right around the time we took my older relative into our apartment to live with us. That's when I first started noticing this whole change... just in how I'm thinking, going about my work, and connecting with people.
Have you noticed any changes in your relationships with friends or family since you started feeling this way?

No, not really. I mean, obviously having my relative move in changed our daily routine at home a bit, but my actual relationships with my family and friends haven't really changed. We still get along fine. I haven't noticed any distance or issues between us, if that's what you mean. Things are pretty much the same on that front.
How long have you felt like you've lost interest in the activities you used to enjoy?

I haven't really noticed losing interest in my activities, to be honest. I still do the things I normally do... it's just that general empty feeling I mentioned earlier. But as far as giving up hobbies or stopping the things I usually do, I haven't really experienced that.
Do you ever feel sad or hopeless, even if it's just for a short time?

No, not really. I wouldn't say I feel sad... and definitely not hopeless. It's really just that empty feeling I was talking about before. But actual sadness, or feeling like things are hopeless? No, I haven't experienced that.
